lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Midnight. Rain. She walked in with flour on her hands... and a copycat problem.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Every post I make, the bakery across the street copies by morning.

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Then we watch her. Public pages only. Five free tools.

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Two AM. She changed her prices. We knew in sixty seconds.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: She's launching a lavender croissant... on Friday?

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Then you launch yours on Thursday.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: A year of copying me... and now she's a day behind.

lines.speaker: june
